sections.eyebrow: Who We Are | Advanced Electricity Infrastructure
sections.heading: About Us
sections.body: Ba-Suka (meaning 'women's home' in Mooré) builds Burkina Faso's first smart electricity network. We deliver affordable, sustainable power through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries — powering electric mobility, businesses, and homes where grid access fails. Led by Carolyn Wright, our 100% solar, women-managed infrastructure is grid-independent and built specifically for the rugged Sahel environment.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: Ba-Suka Energy delivers affordable, sustainable electricity through smart, portable, swappable batteries — powering electric mobility, businesses, and homes across Burkina Faso and West Africa.

sections.eyebrow: Our Vision | Burkina Faso's First Smart Electricity Network
sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.body: Ba-Suka Energy will build an advanced, smart, customer-driven electricity network powered by renewable energy — delivering reliable clean power where grid access fails.

items.title: Accessible → Women-Led Infrastructure
items.body: Managed by certified Yennenga Warriors to build deep community trust and ensure operational excellence. We provide affordable electricity via pay-per-swap SIRA™ access.

items.title: Reliable → Smart Electricity Network
items.body: 99%+ uptime where national grids fail. Our network uses SIRA™ batteries optimized by IoT and solar redundancy to power mobility, businesses, and homes.

items.title: Renewable → 100% Solar-Charged
items.body: Grid-independent Swap & Glow™ stations running on 100% clean rooftop power. We displace imported fuels while ensuring a sustainable second-life strategy for all batteries.

items.title: Professional → The 'Yennenga' Legacy
items.body: Rooted in the spirit of Burkina Faso's legendary warrior-princess. We drive local economic growth by empowering women as professional infrastructure leaders through the Ba-Suka Academy.

items.title: Ba-Suka Academy
items.body: Professional training for the women who run our stations.

items.title: Partnership
items.body: Build Africa's clean-energy infrastructure with us.

items.title: Impact
items.body: IoT-verified impact data, ready for your ESG portfolio.

sections.heading: We are currently seeking infrastructure funds and climate partners who value transparent, IoT-verified impact data
sections.body: Ba-Suka Energy is more than a mobility provider; we are a data-driven infrastructure network. By joining our September 2026 launch, you are investing in a verified ecosystem targeting 1,200 tonnes of CO₂ avoidance and $10M in local economic activity by Year 3. Our SIRA™ smart batteries provide real-time, blockchain-ready metrics on energy throughput and carbon displacement, ensuring your ESG investments deliver measurable, high-fidelity results in the Sahel.
